computationAlternatives.precondition:
NoGroupFilled(Discounts*)
or

( ;; There is only one discount, but it does not fill the price range or is before or after it
  NumberOfFilledFields(Discounts*/Discount)==1 and
  AtLeastOneFieldFilled(Discounts*/Start,Discounts*/End) and
  (
   ( AtLeastOneFieldFilled(Discounts*/Start) and
     (FirstFilledValue(Discounts*/Start) > [Pricing/Start]
       or FieldNotFilled(Pricing/Start)
       or FirstFilledValue(Discounts*/Start) > [Pricing/End] 
      )
    )  
    or
    (AtLeastOneFieldFilled(Discounts*/End)  and
      (FirstFilledValue(Discounts*/End) < [Pricing/End] 
        or FieldNotFilled(Pricing/End)
        or FirstFilledValue(Discounts*/End) < [Pricing/Start]   
      )
    ) 
  )
)or(
;; There are multiple discounts, but either 
;; A: there is a gap day before a discount that starts within the current price
;; OR B: the price is unlimited while the discounts are limited (to either side) 
;; OR  C: there is no discount covering either the start or the end of the price range 

NumberOfFilledFields(Discounts*/Discount)>1 and
(  ;; A:
  AtLeastOneFieldFilled(Discounts*/Discount Having
   ([Discounts/Helper_ThereIsAGapBeforeTheStartDate]==True
     and [Discounts/Start] > [$Pricing/Start]
     and [Discounts/Start] <=[$Pricing/End]
  ))
 
 or   ;; B:
 (FieldNotFilled(Pricing/End) and 
  NumberOfFilledFields(Discounts*/End) ==NumberOfFilledFields(Discounts*/Discount) )
 or
 (FieldNotFilled(Pricing/Start) and 
  NumberOfFilledFields(Discounts*/Start) ==NumberOfFilledFields(Discounts*/Discount) )
 or  ;;  C:
  NumberOfFilledFields(Discounts*/Discount Having
    ( [Discounts/Start] <= [$Pricing/Start] and
      ([Discounts/End] > [$Pricing/Start] 
        or FieldNotFilled(Discounts/End))    
    )
  ) == 0
 or 
  NumberOfFilledFields(Discounts*/Discount Having
   ( [Discounts/End] >= [$Pricing/End] and
      ([Discounts/Start] < [$Pricing/End] 
        or FieldNotFilled(Discounts/Start))    
   )
  ) == 0
)
)

;; There is only one discount and it overlaps with the price

NumberOfFilledFields(Discounts*/Discount)==1 And
(
  NoFieldFilled(Discounts*/Start, Discounts*/End)
  or
  (NoFieldFilled(Discounts*/Start) and 
    FirstFilledValue(Discounts*/End)  >= [Pricing/End])
  or  
  (NoFieldFilled(Discounts*/End) and 
    FirstFilledValue(Discounts*/Start)  <= [Pricing/Start])
   or
   (FirstFilledValue(Discounts*/Start)  <= [Pricing/Start] and
    FirstFilledValue(Discounts*/End)  >= [Pricing/End]) 
)

computationAlternatives.operation:
RoundAccounting(
{1- MinValue(Discounts*/Discount Having
 (
   ( [Discounts/Start] >= [$Pricing/Start] and
     [Discounts/Start] <= [$Pricing/End] )
   or 
   ( [Discounts/Start] <= [$Pricing/Start] and
      ([Discounts/End] > [$Pricing/Start] 
       or FieldNotFilled(Discounts/End))    
    )
   or 
    ( [Discounts/End] >= [$Pricing/Start] and
      FieldNotFilled(Discounts/Start)   
    )
  ) 
)/ 100 } * [Pricing/Price], 2)
computationAlternatives.precondition:
;; There are multiple discounts, none have a gap within the prices date range and there is atleast one discount that covers the start of the price range and one that covers the end of the date range. -> due to the combination of both, this already means, that there is a continous overlap of discounts. so there might be more than 2 discounts that are directely next to each other and span the price date range.

NumberOfFilledFields(Discounts*/Discount)>1 and
NoFieldFilled(Discounts*/Discount Having
   ([Discounts/Helper_ThereIsAGapBeforeTheStartDate]==True
     and [Discounts/Start] > [$Pricing/Start]
     and [Discounts/Start] <=[$Pricing/End]
  ))
and
 NumberOfFilledFields(Discounts*/Discount Having
  ( [Discounts/Start] <= [$Pricing/Start] and
      ([Discounts/End] > [$Pricing/Start] 
        or FieldNotFilled(Discounts/End))    
  )
 ) > 0
and 
 NumberOfFilledFields(Discounts*/Discount Having
  ( [Discounts/End] >= [$Pricing/End] and
      ([Discounts/Start] < [$Pricing/End] 
        or FieldNotFilled(Discounts/Start))    
  )
 )> 0
